about: The structure of bringing up a change: the events a person learns of and the ways they hold someone to blame. It holds no sentences; they come from the mined bank (data/english/parts/bring-it-up.json) through src/english/mined/scene-bank.ts. A change row marked story is a printed story a reader remembers: its subject is the outlet that printed it and its topic is read from the story record; no one is blamed for it.

remembered.about: What a person brings up from their own life in a talk (the life record, part 2): an event both people remember, or one of the speaker's own from the last year, weighed by how close the two are (closeness.ts) and how much the event changed a life (these weights). No sentences: they come from the bring-it-up bank's parts whose use has subject remembered and role <life>/<what>.

ownWithinDays.checkedAgainst: The item's own words (owner's design, docs/design/life-record.md): one of the speaker's own from the last year; checked against how long a played year's events stay news between neighbors (a year to two).

loss.source: Holmes and Rahe (1967), The Social Readjustment Rating Scale, Journal of Psychosomatic Research 11(2):213-218: mean life change units per event, divided by 100 (death of a spouse).
